verdict.rationale: Databricks provides multiple automation surfaces (CLI, Python SDK, REST APIs, Jobs API) explicitly meant for scripting operations across many objects, and Auto Loader/ETL pipelines are built to incrementally process large volumes of files/data at once, supporting bulk-style workflows. However, there's no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'bulk operations' API (e.g., batch create/update/delete across many catalog objects or jobs in one call) or hands-on evidence of an AI-native user driving such bulk actions end-to-end. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch endpoint documentation for many-item operations, and independent confirmation of bulk workflows in practice.
